# Shreyas Pandey

> AIML Engineer. Long-form articles on AI, software engineering, agents, and the tech landscape.

## Articles

- [Dear First Year: Nobody Will Tell You This, So I Will](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/dear-first-year-nobody-will-tell-you-this-so-i-will): A senior letter to first-year engineering students on CGPA, skills, hackathons, and building in public.
- [The Last 30 Days of AI Multiverse](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/the-last-30-days-of-ai-multiverse): June 2026 AI industry retrospective — open-source models from China, US policy, Cursor acquisition, sovereign AI in India.
- [The $60 Question: Are Cursor's AI Tokens Actually Subsidized?](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/the-60-question-are-cursors-ai-tokens-actually-subsidized): Investigation using one month of real Cursor Pro+ usage data vs public API pricing.
- [MiniMax's M2 Series: The clearest public blueprints for agent-native LLMs](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/minimaxs-m2-series-the-clearest-public-blueprints-for-agent-native-llms): Deep dive on M2, M2.5, and M2.7 — mini activations, long-context attention, agentdata, and RL for tools.
- [The AI Engineering Roadmap](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/the-ai-engineering-roadmap): 2026 structured path from Python developer to production-ready AI engineer with agentic systems focus.
- [AI Engineering Roadmap for Software Engineers](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/ai-engineering-roadmap-for-software-engineers): Fast-track path for engineers who already know Python and FastAPI to build agentic AI systems.
- [Claude vs GPT: X Algorithm Analysis](https://www.shreyaspandey.me/blogs/i-made-claude-opus-46-max-and-gpt-55-analyze-the-x-algorithm-then-i-made-them-judge-each-other): Both models analyzed the open-source X For You algorithm, then judged each other's analysis.
